name: protein-domains
title: Protein Domains
description: A protein along its length: a thin backbone, domains as tall rounded blocks named inside where they fit, overlapping domains on lanes, a residue ruler, a legend, and variants as lollipops with pill labels stacked to avoid collisions; secondary structure (helices as coils, strands as arrows, structureFromDssp) and per-residue confidence such as AlphaFold pLDDT (bars in AlphaFold's bands) as tracks on the same scale, with a residue guide through every track, a hover card and a keyboard stop.
